claims.text: If run exactly as specified, this design decides: the card's PROXY value for af2_h_per_run (0.5) holds on the card's own protocol, measured in its phase p1_pilot (Run the 54-run pilot (3 capsids x 3 receptors) on 8x A100 and measure af2_h_per_run, md_ns_per_day_a100, aux_h_per_pair and seed-to-seed SD of calls.) on one rented box.
